verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents run as deployed agents that handle conversations and act on their own, using multi-step workflows built in a visual builder and webhook tools that trigger authenticated actions such as scheduling meetings or initiating returns. However, every evidenced automation runs inside a live voice or chat conversation; nothing shows the agents working unattended in the background. Missing for 10: scheduled or cron-style runs, event triggers independent of a conversation, background or batch job execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
